name: real-skills
description: Everyday engineering skills: changelog (release notes from promotion PRs or tags, linked to your tracker), quick-ask-me (short interview that ends in an implementation brief) ask-and-create-specs (interview that ends in a terse, line-capped spec) , wtf (read-only bug-report triage with a checked verdict), calibrate (switches on logged Jev questions once they have earned it) and handoff-with-prompt (writes a handoff file and prints a prompt for the next agent). do-shit is Claude Code only.

interface.shortDescription: Changelogs, planning interviews, terse specs and bug-report triage
